recentItems.title: Resident Evil - Official State of Play Clip | State of Play 2026
recentItems.description:
Resident Evil will be scaring its way to theaters on September 18, 2026, and director Zach Cregger stopped by the latest State of Play to share an exclusive clip of the action that is set to unfold very shortly.

Say hello to Austin Abrams' Bryan, who is running through a snowy city street when zombies start falling from the skies. On the bright side, this encounter makes him realize that they actually can die... so there's that!

recentItems.description: Take a look at the Lore Trailer for nopixel V, the hit role-playing experience within Grand Theft Auto Online and GTA 5, developed by nopixel Studios in collaboration with Rockstar Games. Return to Los Santos on your own terms in nopixel V for Grand Theft Auto Online and GTA 5, available now for PC.

Exodus: Five Things You Need to Know
recentItems.description:
We’re rapidly approaching three years since the world got its first look at Exodus. A lot has happened in the world since 2023 - many games have come and gone in the span between. It would be fair to question if Exodus has kept pace with the movements of the market.

Happily, all this time has gone to good use. Developer Archetype Entertainment, backed by legendary tabletop game publisher Wizards of the Coast, are now on the downhill run on this science fiction sprawler and it’s finally time to wrap our mitts around a gamepad and get stuck in. Archetype is rightly avoiding Grand Theft of Your Time in November and touching down on April 7, 2027 instead, so now’s the perfect time for a progress check-in.

recentItems.description: Take a look at the Gameplay Trailer for nopixel V, the hit role-playing experience within Grand Theft Auto Online and GTA 5, developed by nopixel Studios in collaboration with Rockstar Games. Players can get a look at the evolution of GTA Online RP with new ways to play, lives to embody, and enhancements to Los Santos itself. nopixel V for Grand Theft Auto Online and GTA 5 is available now for PC.
